1 . This is first application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant in connection with Crime No.356/2023 registered at Police Station - Machalpura, Rajgarh (M.P.)
under Section 34(2) of M.P. Excise Act, 1915 and Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC.
2.

As per prosecution story, on 29.10.2023 the police allegedly received a discreet information form a trusted source that a red colour 'Eicher' Truck bearing registration No. NL-01-K-9864 which is coming from Rajasthan side is carrying liquor.

It is alleged that on receiving the said tip, the police team reached the post-Ghotakpur, where they saw a red colour Either Truck bearing NO.
NL-01-K-9864, coming from Bakani side, as was mentioned in the discreet information.
3. It is also alleged that on seeing police personnel near Post-Ghotakpur the driver of the said vehicle tried to flee the spot but was nabbed by police.

sentences.text: It is further alleged that the present applicant had told the police that the truck is loaded with rice bags and he has 'Builty' for the same.
It is also alleged that thereafter the police personnel searched the said truck and found few bags filled with husk.
Allegedly, on further search of the vehicle, few boxes on which 'Imperial Blue' was printed, were found below the said bags.
It is also alleged that on opening the said boxes imported liquor bottles were found.
It is alleged that in total 670 boxes of liquor i.e. 5945 bulk liters of liquor was found from the said vehicle.
4. Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in jail since 30.10.2023, the charge-sheet has been filed and no further custodial interrogation is required.
5. Counsel for the State opposes the prayer and submits that a huge quantity of liquor of worth Rs.1.15 Crore has been seized.
The applicant was driver of the vehicle and was caught at the spot and one co-accused is absconding.
It is further argued that he is the resident of State of Haryana.

6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the investigation has been filed, the charge-sheet has been filed, no further custodial interrogation is required,
admittedly, this is first criminal case of the applicant and there is no criminal record, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled for grant of conditional bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, the present application is allowed.

7. It is directed that Applicant- Laksh alias Lakshya shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with one local surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below on the following conditions :-
(i) that applicant shall not indulge in any offence during the pendency of trial and if he indulges in any offence during the bail, the prosecution may file an application for cancellation of bail and (ii) the applicant shall mark his presence before the concerned police on every 15th day of the month during the pendency of trial.
8. A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the court below.
C.c. as per rules.

(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE soumya Laksh Alias Lakshya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172137701/
